svg.title: Long wavelength: wavefronts and spreading angle
svg.desc: Same opening and same screen distance as the paired case. Opening width 2 model units; wavelength 1 model units. Line 1 is the forward axis. Line 2 runs from the same slit centre toward the first far-field dark band. Theta is the angle between these lines, not the curvature of a wavefront. The screen shows a normalised far-field pattern. Near-field wavefront sketch and distant screen are schematic, not to scale. Outgoing crests remain visible outside the central-band reference directions.
